metadata.calibration: disjoint held-out sigmoid calibration for base model and learned hybrid
limitations: Dataset-conditioned calibrated probabilities are not a guarantee of field performance or confirmed maliciousness.
Labels and source collection biases are inherited from the documented dataset; source-level and temporal generalization are not established.
Lexical near-duplicate grouping does not detect all semantic paraphrases. Email inputs are bounded to16000 characters; URL inputs to8192.
No destination fetching, DNS, reputation lookup, authentication verification or attachment execution is performed by the model.
Main phishing and legitimate labels are confounded with corpus family; source artifacts remain despite removed metadata and source/era stress tests.
Figshare label0 is inherited legitimate/ham labeling; not independent modern security adjudication. Generic spam label1 is excluded, never claimed as phishing.

Figshare curators license their release CC BY4.0; their original constituent corpora have separate collection and original-sender rights history. Explicit curator permission does not authenticate original senders.
External MASC legitimate labels are contextual routine-email genre, not security annotations. Only80 original documents before cleaning.
Nazario hand labeling can contain errors and collection/anonymization/era bias; curated real inbox data is not exhaustive.
Template and thread disjointness is lexical and bounded to the shared first600-token representation; semantic/paraphrased campaigns may remain related.
Offline language screening can misclassify short, mixed-language or technical emails; normalized langid score is not model confidence.
Artificial class balance and corpus-era biases prevent interpreting benchmark calibration as deployment prevalence calibration.
metadata.dataset_license: CC BY 4.0 (Nazario and Figshare); external MASC CC BY 3.0 US
metadata.validation_scope: Offline English corpus benchmark and limited external historical legitimate/newer inbox phishing stress evaluation. This does not establish broad English mail accuracy, source-independent generalization or deployment confidence.
metadata.prediction_warning: Limited English research model: frozen external phishing recall was 39.2% and Brier score 0.449. Historical-corpus calibration did not transfer to newer email. A legitimate prediction must not be treated as safety; review heuristic evidence.
metadata.probability_scope: Historical English corpus only; weak external calibration

release_evaluation.note: Post-evaluation disclosure only. No model, threshold, heuristic score, split, or calibration fitting changed after external evaluation.
